registration and real state producer: Actual @Mod common setup registers ReviveEventServer and all three packets; player AttachCapabilities provides LazyOptional<Bleeding>. HIGHEST LivingDeath on server requires active configuration (creative exception, singleplayer flag or published server) and non-bypass source. A first qualifying death removes the player from helper lists, sends helper-stop, calls knockOut via startBleeding, dismounts if needed, cancels death, adjusts hunger and health. knockOut initializes bleeding/progress/downedTime/timeLeft and saves source/tracker. Already-bleeding death clears current helpers and returns without cancelling; bypass sources skip this entire block. Native Forge listener composition is not verified.
actual damage refusal while downed: LivingHurt first checks bleeding, then lets bypass sources through. Otherwise bledOut, downedTime <= initialDamageCooldown, and independently configured player/mob/other source categories can setCanceled(true). Initial grace is inclusive; flags do not form universal invulnerability. Nonbleeding helper damage optionally removes helper membership. Death/Hurt and active-check conditions differ; hurt listener has no isReviveActive condition. PlayerMixin visibility and optional push refusal read the same state. These generic predicates are support0 under the one cooperative mechanism.
helper admission and membership transfer: Server EntityInteract targeting a bleeding player cancels the interaction. Optional required item checks helper main hand; first consumptive admission shrinks one unless creative, sets inventory changed and target itemConsumed. Once itemConsumed is true, later admissions still enter the else-if ingredient check, but do not shrink again. After these checks, removePlayerAsHelper removes the helper from every current server player list, then adds it to this target and sends HelperPacket(targetUUID,true). The handler itself has no explicit helper-alive/nonbleeding, distance, same-dimension or line-of-sight guard; native interaction pipeline constraints not expanded. Failed item check leaves old membership unchanged. Removal-before-add prevents ordinary repeated interaction from accumulating duplicate entries, not arbitrary API mutations.
competing progress and bleed timer consumer: Server START PlayerTick requires active configuration and alive target, then ticks only bleeding state. Bleeding.tick forces swimming when current pose differs, removes helpers whose numeric distance is >maxDistance and sends stop to those helpers. It does not separately check level identity, alive, current held item, sustained button hold or current bleeding state. If no helpers OR haltBleedTime=false, decrement timeLeft; if none AND resetProgress=true, zero progress. Then add remaining helper count * progressPerPlayer, increment downedTime, and request configured helper food exhaustion. Parent sends snapshots every five downed ticks and applies configured effects/hunger before checking revived progress first, then bledOut. If both predicates true that tick, revive wins. Effects admission results ignored; progress does not depend on hunger payment success.
authoritative release and terminal path: revive clears Bleeding state first, requests configured effects, resetPlayer sends stop to current helpers and clears list/PersistentData flag, syncs, writes healthAfter, requests revived sound, posts PlayerRevivedEvent, syncs again, releases forced pose. Event comment says before revived but actual call follows state/health writes. kill posts PlayerBleedOutEvent (not used as a returned veto), restores original combat snapshot, writes HP0, forceBledOut, calls die(saved/fallback source), clears helpers/flag with an intermediate snapshot, then clears Bleeding state and forced pose and sends final snapshot. Marking bleeding/time0 before die prevents its own first-death rescue branch from rearming. The native die result/cross-mod cancellation is not certified; reset occurs even if native death is intercepted. Logout bleeding calls kill; permission2 command directly revives bleeding targets. Optional upstream ban policy is read as context only and is never proposed for Dynasty.
actual consumer and acknowledgement boundary: ReviveUpdatePacket snapshots target UUID and serialized timeLeft/progress/bleeding/consumed. Client execution looks up that UUID in current Minecraft level, drops absent target, deserializes into capability and forces STANDING if false. HelperPacket independently writes static helpActive/helpTarget. Registered RenderGuiOverlayEvent.Post consumer shows helper target time/progress if helper is not bleeding, helpActive, GUI visible, no screen and target UUID resolves. It does not test target.isBleeding or actual helper membership. Victim overlay reads own state, applies pose/handsBusy/missTime and local jump effect; on nonbleeding overlay it restores post effect, clears jump/handsBusy and explicitly stops owned sound. Low-level CreativeCore delivery, native graphics/shader/audio engine internals are not expanded; no visual/audio success claim.
incomplete notification coverage is an observed chain property: removePlayerAsHelper only removes from server lists and sends no HelperPacket. Damage abort calls only that helper. Therefore under abortOnDamage=true, a removed helper can retain helpActive=true and a resolved old target overlay: later target reset iterates remaining helpers, so it does not notify the removed one. Distance pruning does send stop; switching targets sends a new start; first knockOut of the helper sends stop; target normal revive/kill sends stop to helpers still present. A bypass-source death skips the playerDied helper cleanup, and already-bleeding non-bypass death only clears helpers there, not all bleeding state. These are static branch observations, not runtime reproduced defects. No claim every death/logout/dimension change is covered.
give-up and client lifecycle boundaries: Client END tick increments a local hold counter while bleeding and attack held; sends GiveUpPacket only when prior counter > seconds*20 then resets it. Server checks only sender bleeding before kill, not hold duration. Render callback has no per-overlay-type filter here, so do not infer one call per frame. Helper static fields have no disconnect/session reset in the complete local Java files; target lookup includes current world but packet carries no dimension/session/sequence and no queue. If player is null, render cleanup does not run; absence of a drawn target is not clearing helpActive. Audio TensionSound tick is empty, so owned sound stop must not be inferred from that wrapper alone. These are support limits, not extra UI/transport credits.

item plus category transport: MessageLockedItem constructor stores stack reference, not copy; byte codec serializes ItemStack and UTF8 message key only. No failing requirement, threshold, server level, target UUID, world, nonce or action generation. PacketHandler registers actual CLIENT handler. onMessage schedules on Minecraft task queue, handleMessage calls HUDHandler.setLockMessage. separate live profile data: Login PlayerData.sync→API→ReskillableModAccess sends MessageDataSync with saveToNBT snapshot of SkillLevels. Client scheduled handler resolves current player through ClientProxy and loadFromNBT→PlayerSkillInfo overwrites level/points/unlocks for included skills. MessageLevelUp actual server handler can levelUp then saveAndSync after its gates; exact XP-helper internals not expanded or credited. No action ID binds these data packets to a particular MessageLockedItem. ConfigHandler reads local lock configuration; config-change load only replaces pending configLocks and does not itself call setupLocks. No same-time configuration/version field in refusal packet.
real client consumer recomputes explanation: ClientProxy registers HUDHandler and ClientTickHandler. On overlay ALL while lockTime>0, HUD reads current local player data and LevelLockHandler.getSkillLock(lockedItem) every render. Draws translated refusal category header red, then skill icons and requested level numbers red/green according to current local skill level. GuiSkills.drawSkill uses current profile rank and texture; RenderHelper submits concrete textured quad. Thus packet reports rejection category/item while detailed condition explanation is reconstructed from current local definitions and independently synced profile, not server failure witness. It lists all local skill/advancement requirements, not only the one that failed.
render coverage and early exit boundaries: RequirementRegistry supports skill, adv and trait; HUD separates only SkillRequirement and AdvancementRequirement. An unresolved advancement causes return after outer pushMatrix and before matching final popMatrix; null display has no guard. explicit lifespan and exits: setLockMessage replaces static item/message and sets40 on every receipt, with no dedup or throttle. END client tick decrements only when currentScreen null or doesGuiPauseGame false. World-null branch only PlayerDataHandler.cleanup; no HUD clear, dimension/actor key, dead-player clear, successful retry clear or item-switch clear. lockTime<=0 prevents drawing; stored item/message refs are retained. Last<10 uses partialTicks alpha clamped minimum0.05. Repeated receipts can prolong display; pausing can preserve remaining clock. count_unit: one complete projectile-to-observer removal veto, target-bound sampled group cleanup and independent childTTL policy; wrappers/helpers/variants/storage0 extra
full_chain_observation:
concrete registered producer: Reused actual EvilCraft.onConfigsRegister adds ItemNecromancerStaffConfig, EntityControlledZombieConfig, EntityNecromancersHeadConfig. Previously read base callbacks create/register concrete factories; entity configs select controlled renderer and native ThrownItemRenderer. New ObjectHolder declarations bind controlled_zombie and necromancers_head. Staff.use gets current hand stack, canConsume usage then calls consume ignoring returned amount, constructs/throws head, returns SUCCESS. Without canConsume, actual ItemBloodContainer.use fallback also returns SUCCESS, even no fluid change. No typed refused-summon message.

input resource boundary, no separate credit: Own-item canDrain compares exact simulated amount. Otherwise canConsume checks only nonempty simulated drainFromOthers, not requested total. drainFromOthers cumulatively adds drained, but subtracts cumulative amount from remaining on each iteration, and its final nonempty&&empty condition is impossible. consume EXECUTE only for null player or noncreative server player; creative/client SIMULATE. Parent capability writes Fluid NBT; native Forge drain internals not read. Staff does not verify consume result, does not refund on head/child spawn failure; no full payment claim. Extended inventory iterator reads registered locations, not proof every external inventory provider semantics.

projectile hit admission: throwNecromancersHead constructs on either side, sets mobType and shoots/adds only server; addFreshEntity return ignored. mobType field/setter unused by spawnSwarm, which always constructs ControlledZombie. Head.onHit acts only ENTITY, not observing, server. Calls target.hurt(thrown(owner),0) before qualifications and ignores result. Then requires ServerPlayer owner, hit not owner, hit LivingEntity to spawnSwarm; otherwise discard. No alive gate, source immunity result gate or final rejection receipt. Block/client/already-observing hits have no local action in override; no inherited impact behavior claimed.

child list and target state: spawnSwarm loops random3..4, constructs each child; canAttackType override true. Copies necromancer position, moves randomXZ, calls Core EntityHelpers.spawnEntity. Helper calls Forge onFinalizeSpawn; non-null SpawnGroupData triggers world.addFreshEntity but ignores its boolean and returns true. Thus observables list means helper-qualified, not proved added entity. Regardless helper result, qualifying child then receives setTarget(original hit entity) and TTL200. After loop head stores target and enters observer mode even if list empty. No child owner UUID/reference set; target may later change via native goals. No guarantee actual mob melee since native goals/caller not expanded and MeleeAttackGoal was put in targetSelector.

observer removal veto and cleanup: setObserverMode sets observing=true, motion0, invisible=true. Head.remove delegates to super only when !observing, vetoing any reason while flagtrue. Actual tick first super.tick then, only observing and server and efficientTick(level,10), scans list. Shared helper uses random.nextInt(10)==0 (no parameters), not every10th tick. Dead child removed from list; if original target not alive, each living child discarded and removed. When list empty, clears observing then calls remove(DISCARDED), now permitted. Target death cleanup is sampled, not instant. No explicit owner-alive, distance, dimension or owner-held-item gate. Motion set once, no noGravity flag or pre-super stop, so not guaranteed stationary observer.

independent child lifetime and reload boundary: Child defineSynchedData TTL0; staff sets200. Child aiStep super first then server getsTTL, predecrements/stores, and discards only if result==0. Normal positive TTL reaches0; initial/missing-key0 becomes-1 and does not expire on that step, no <=0 or clamp. NBT saves/reads rawttl alongside superclass, so remaining child life survives own data roundtrip; target/owner is not custom saved here. Head observing/target/observables are plain fields with no custom NBT read/write or synced-data definition, no load reconstruction. No persistent observer-child identity/UUID linkage or restart repair demonstrated. Parent native serialization/unload semantics not expanded; veto of remove does not prove process/world unload persistence.

actual feedback consumer and its limits: Head ItemSupplier returns skeleton skull; registered native ThrownItemRenderer receives it. Observer invokes native invisible flag but local observing/list/target have no custom network fields. Controlled renderer selects texture and delegates model aggression to entity.isAggressive; does not read TTL or emit expiration/refusal cue. Actual Advancements.NECROMANCE is registered via helper to CriteriaTriggers and test(player,target) is called after observer transition regardless empty list or world-add result; instance checks only target EntityPredicate, not number spawned/payment. Advancement UI delivery/data not inspected. No dedicated success or rejection sound/message in this chain; visual/native tracking not runtime-verified.
concrete_observation: Observer denies all own remove reasons while observing; random server poll drops dead children or those bound to dead original target, clears flag only when reference list empty, then removes. Each child independently predecrements saved rawTTL and discards exactly at0. Spawn-list membership is helper-finalize success, not acknowledged native world add; no owner UUID/control guarantee.
application_to_boss_immune: Separate observer lifetime from child lifetime, use actual world-add acknowledgement for membership, and make cleanup state recoverable or explicitly transient. A target assignment or visual/advancement attempt does not prove control or successful creation.
limitations:
At most1 for the complete projectile→observer removal-veto→sampled target-bound group cleanup plus independent childTTL policy. No helper/class/parameter/child variant/persistence credit.
Do not repeat staff comment claims: target death cleanup is sampled, and no-drop/low-HP claims are not established by these classes/loot sources.
observables membership is not actual spawn acknowledgement. An unadded but alive constructed child could remain in list; native world-add/tick behavior not asserted or leak reproduced.
remove veto covers every RemovalReason in override, but no claim it safely prevents native chunk unload/server shutdown or that it is damage immunity.
TTL0 does not remove after predecrement; raw int arithmetic includes eventual wraparound, so do not claim mathematical immortality. Spawn egg config exists without custom positiveTTL initialization; native egg spawn path not expanded.
No source payment proof, source damage-result proof, owner identity binding on children, guaranteed AI attack, packet ack or group cleanup atomicity.
Same Core tag support boundary as034: binary build750 correspondence not independently proved. No native or upstream code executed.
Own EntityControlledZombie is an ordinary Monster with one initial target assignment, not player-owned control entitlement; canAttackType true does not settle all native attack admission. MeleeAttackGoal appears in targetSelector, native execution not expanded.
Observer remove override is a source-owned removal veto, not universal damage immunity or proven native unload persistence. super.tick runs first and motion is zeroed once; no permanent stationary/noGravity guarantee.
Helper success only means Forge finalize returned nonnull, not native addFreshEntity true. Child target/TTL written after helper regardless helper result; criterion test occurs after observer transition even empty membership.
Staff input route returns success on fallback too. canConsume only checks external drain nonempty, and cumulative subtraction may undercount remaining request; no full fluid payment/refund or native provider behavior certified. Empty first extended inventory could stop iteration; conditional local hasNext boundary, not reproduced external provider failure.
Child lifetime saves rawTTL; fresh/missing0 predecrements negative, exactzero removal not <=0. Raw integer eventual wraparound precludes mathematical immortality claim. Head has no own saved/synced observation link; native parent serialization and Forge tracking not newly read.
No generic summon-only class credit: one whole projectile-to-removal-veto observer and sampled target/group cleanup with independently saved childTTL. Payment/renderer/advancement/NBT/helpers and constants all support0.
No game/native attack/world-add/collision/unload/packet/pixels, binary Core build750 correspondence, model/texture/building or Dynasty production acceptance.033 stays0.

count_unit: one complete semantically distinct current-item wear clamp/refusal/repair lifecycle; two event arms, helpers and recovery producer support0
full_chain_observation:
registered actual native handlers: Existing EvilCraft.onConfigsRegister adds actual EnchantmentUnusingConfig namedunusing. New EnchantmentConfig routes ENCHANTMENT and Forge registry through already-read shared factory/action callbacks; lazy getInstance invokes new EnchantmentUnusing, which registers this instance on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS. Constructor categoryBREAKABLE/mainhand, maxlevel1 and canEnchant(isDamageableItem) are acquisition declarations, not runtime event guards. Native enchanting/loot acquisition not expanded.
actual stack qualification and attack cancellation: NORMAL LivingAttack subscriber first checks target world server and source.getEntity instanceof LivingEntity. Uses that source actor CURRENT MAINHAND, not source.directEntity or a captured attack/projectile stack. EnchantmentHelpers loops raw getEnchantmentTags, compares registry key to each id ResourceLocation and returns first index; no lvl>0 test. If matchingid and unuseTooltrue, setCanceled(true) andreturn. It doesnot stopUsingItem (commented out). No positive damage/source-type/player/creative/target-immunity gate shown; not all entities but any qualifying Living source actor. No explicit alreadycanceled check; Forge dispatch of previously canceled events not expanded.
mutation at refusal boundary: unuseTool computes damageBorder=getMaxDamage()-5. If current getDamageValue>=border, first calls setDamageValue(border), then returns true causing actual cancel. This may request reducing damage from an overshot value to boundary, not simply prevent additional wear; later attempts at exactly boundary refuse again. If below boundary returnsfalse without modifying. No separate lock flag, elapsed timer, stored target, damage acknowledgement or retry counter. It does not check isDamageableItem in the runtime helper, so canEnchant does not prove malformed/enchant-injected stacks are excluded; lowmax negative parameter native normalization unverified.
mining arm and asymmetric release: NORMAL BlockEvent.BreakEvent gets player.getUsedItemHand before null-player check. If handnonnull, looks at that hand stack and same raw enchantid predicate, then unuseTool. On true cancels and calls releaseUsingItem. It doesnot explicitly side-check here or use original digging tool/mainhand unconditionally. Both event overloads share one policy; no perhand/method extra credit. The checked nullplayer condition cannot protect earlier dereferences; only conditional code observation, no engine-null event reproduction.
concrete recovery producer: Existing EvilCraft constructor installs BloodChestRepairActionRegistry; complete registry constructor registers DamageableItemRepairAction first and dispatches selected action. Blood chest/blockentity configs and actual BlockBloodChest.getTicker choose server BlockEntityTickingTankInventory.TickerServer. BlockEntityTickerDelayed.tick invokes update before optional update publication backoff. Server update reads each actual slot and, unless redstone disables ticker, passes current stack to TickComponent. Component chooses Item.class action, canTick, increments progress and invokes onTick; empty/failed qualification resets progress by configured flag. Redstone skips component call, thus doesnot itself reset progress.
repair commits changed stack for later reentry: RepairItemTickAction canTick requires nonempty tank/item plus actions.canRepair. At required ticks, copies stack, reselects action, simulates cost then if fluid amount sufficient invokes repair doAction=true. Damageable action requires isDamaged, requests setDamageValue(current-1), may add random bad enchant, returnsmultiplier1 with stack. Caller then requests tank drain and writes resulting stack to actual slot via inventory.setItem; SimpleInventory stores it in contents then inventory-change callback. No atomic debit guarantee; native drain internals and callback consumers unexpanded. Concrete conditional recovery: if a normal max100 stack at damage95 is repaired successfully to94 and later used in checked hand, unuseTool sees94<95 and doesnot cancel. No timer/reset packet; every action reads current damage. Native inventory transfer, ItemStack normalization and engine successful action remain outside proof.
termination and feedback boundaries: Refusal ceases when current selected stack lacks matching enchantid or current damage is below border; no retained peractor denial state to clear. Switching source mainhand also changes future attribution, including possible projectile-owned events; no originalweapon identity preserved. Source has no dedicated message/sound/particle/criterion or refusal packet. Mining releaseUsingItem is the only explicit use-state stop; native client correction/inventory synchronization not inspected. Blood chest open/close sound relates to openers, not repair success or immunity. No independent durable recovery receipt is claimed.
concrete_observation: One whole current source stack maxDamage-5 clamp before actual attack/break cancellation, and concrete normal repair producer lowers damage to re-admit. Actor equipment, thresholds, both event overloads, releaseUsingItem, blood chest actions/tank/ticks/storage and registry helpers add0 separately. Distinct from target finite shieldbudget/stun, burningNBT new-use/erosion/salvage, player faction/skill reason, independently live HUD requirements, deferred terminal payment, or presence of repair rocks opening another entity. Generic source-mainhand lookup is already present and earns0.033 still0.
application_to_boss_immune: Distinguish actor equipment refusal from target immunity, preserve the actual action stack identity, and define whether rejecting an attempt may mutate/restore resources. Reentry can be current-state-based without a retained lock, but feedback must state the real authoritative reason if added later.
limitations:
At most1 for whole current-stack wear clamp→two event refusals→conditional actual repair/reentry policy. Constants, helpers, two hands/events, source types and repair machine do not earn separate credit.
Source-actor equipment restriction is not Boss target immunity. No Boss gray text or actual rejected-control sound implemented/proven.
Clamping is before cancel; cross-mod final cancellation/side-effect ordering not executed. No rollback guarantee or native durability/inventory exploit claimed.
Enchantment match only identity/index; level0 can satisfy raw tag scan condition. Invalid ID parsing/no registry key may fail; no malformed input tested.

Actual SpellRegistry instance/finalise, potion register, EntityTimeStop and RenderNull registration, message registration and mod lifecycle already read and reused exactly. Actual parent is EntitySpellModifiable directly extending native Entity, not EntitySpellBase/EntityLifetimeBase. Constructor records instance, invisible/size and data-manager lifetime. onUpdate does not call native super; decrements own watched lifetime and setsDirty each delivered update, invokes onDeath and setDead at<=0. No side check in parent. EntityTimeStop.onDeath submits configured end sound. Child then continues its onUpdate without isDead/return gate: client smoke or server application still runs on terminal invocation.
Server child caches AABB on first update using current position/radius, then queries living targets each update. Box is not recomputed after later source movement or config change; not a follow-caster field. Excludes every EntityPlayer. Optional PEACEFUL consults friendly classification; FAMILIARS uses generic owned-familiar test, not recorded caster UUID. There is no EntityUtil.isBoss call here. Actual native potion applicability remains a separate unverified admission gate.
Each admitted-by-scan nonplayer sets static EntityTimeStop.refreshing=true, writes modifier core snapshot to target entityData, attempts addPotionEffect(time_stop,40), then resets static false. SLOW/WEAKNESS extended by40 and FIRE are attempted independently afterward. No result acknowledgment or rollback. Guards tolerate modifiersnull only for first two skip tests; later toArray/has dereference can fail. Flag is process-wide, not target/source keyed and has no finally; exception before reset can leave ittrue.
Exact041 native EventManager.onEntityTick: if target currently has time_stop, first removePotionEffect(time_stop), then event.setCanceled(true), and continues remaining handler branches. It does not set NoAI, velocity or updateBlocked. Thus source effect is a replenished consumable control token, not a40-update durable latch. No native LivingUpdate cancellation contract or event ordering executed; do not assert full physical freeze, exact per-tick coverage or absence of other listeners.

complete_substantive_judgment.full_chain_observation: Native mod preInit prepares/registries register REPELLER block + ItemBlock, stone and vials; native init registers TileEntityRepeller. Bottom-half creation returns the ITickable, top-half interaction redirects to bottom. Actual block activation adds/removes stone, consumes Byariis vial input with fixed loss10 (server fuel mutation) and cycles 0..3 radius states on server empty-hand use. Actual filled-vial creative producer writes dynamic amounts; survival acquisition not researched. ItemAspectContainer.fromItem reads blHerbloreAspects; AspectContainer.get sums dynamic/static storage and set invokes item onChanged write-through when changed. Refill uses added=min(maxFuel-fuel,amount-loss), then removes added+loss from noncreative vial or substitutes its empty container. Withdrawal returns min(fuel,5000) to new vial, but TileEntityRepeller.removeFuel subtracts the requested5000 rather than returned amount, so ordinary partial withdrawals can create negative fuel. Setter/client inventory operations are not all server guarded. update first sets running from fuel>0 && hasShimmerstone, announcing transitions. Then fuel<0 clamps to0 and skips the entire entity/cost branch. Otherwise entity/cost branch runs even with fuel==0, running==false or missing stone. Hence nominal power qualification is not final control admission. The nested fuel>0/fuel<=0 branch is unreachable and does not pre-clamp zero. Server query uses current radius+5 AABB, actual center=(block+.5,+1.15,+.5). IMob targets except EntityWight and IBLBoss pass only if nearest of eight AABB corners has squared distance strictly less than radius squared. Before billing, call move(PISTON,diffX*.1,0,diffZ*.1), overwrite motionX/Z with unit-from-pre-move-position times ((radius-len)/radius*1.5+.5), and attempt SLOWNESS10 amp6 on LivingBase. No hurt call or native knockback attribute query. Cost contribution only when collidedHorizontally is false after the move call; movement/potion acceptance is not returned as an authoritative result. Independent if(IProjectile || EntityFireball), so mob exclusions do not globally guard this branch. Same corner gate, captures current speed then horizontal piston move and writes all motion components radial with that speed. IProjectile.shoot(radialUnit,1,1) follows and may replace the prior velocity; sets velocityChanged=true. Bills only if !collidedHorizontally && !collidedVertically && !onGround. No owner/acceleration/hit-set reset or impact cancel. Concrete/native shoot implementations not expanded; final speed/trajectory unproven. public static final MemoryModuleType<Integer> RAM_COOLDOWN_TICKS = register("ram_cooldown_ticks", Codec.INT);
   public static final MemoryModuleType<Vec3> RAM_TARGET = register("ram_target");
public static final SensorType<NearestLivingEntitySensor<LivingEntity>> NEAREST_LIVING_ENTITIES = register("nearest_living_entities", NearestLivingEntitySensor::new);
public static final EntityType<Goat> GOAT = register("goat", EntityType.Builder.of(Goat::new, MobCategory.CREATURE).sized(0.9F, 1.3F).clientTrackingRange(10));

author_verbatim: One proposed related native preparation-to-contact/terrain termination whole only, maximum1 pending Main or merge0. Complete old charge/dash/Goety judgments and groups, native finite-horn owner+duplicate+Main correction, Milk22/11 and pendingAxolotlMain21/12 plus pendingSonic20/12 read before newsource. Horn custody/instrument/age reset, milk, generic knockback/shield/Brain/expiry/timers/sensors/species/render/helper wrappers0extra.

Actual native EntityType.GOAT factory references Goat::new; Goat registers actual nearest-living sensor and RAM_TARGET/RAM_COOLDOWN memory, makeBrain delegates GoatAi. Own customServerAiStep ticks Brain before GoatAi.updateActivity and parent. This links actual native actor to behaviors, not naturalspawn/runtime acceptance or complete outer NoAI/scheduler verification.

Whole GoatAi installs CORE including MoveToTargetSink and CountDownCooldownTicks(RAM_COOLDOWN), then RAM priority0 RamTarget and priority1 PrepareRamNearestTarget. RAM activity requires no temptingplayer, breedtarget or cooldown. updateActivity picks RAM before longjump/idle. Helper initMemories writes normal600..6000 even before variant-specific later finish sampling; callers/actualspawn outside this bounded actor read are not certified.

Whole nearest-living sensor queries inflated16 box, excludes self/dead in its own predicate, sorts by actor distance, writes list plus visible wrapper. Wrapper findClosest traverses sorted snapshot and caches Sensor.isEntityTargetable per target. Sensor default random initial0..19 and interval20 are sensor invocations, not fresh every-frame visibility or wallclock guarantee. Registered actual sensor factory read.

RAM_TARGET_CONDITIONS is forCombat with explicit !GOAT type and worldborder boundingbox selector. Whole TargetingConditions default LOS is enabled and range remains-1; it calls canBeSeenByAnyone, actor canAttack/canAttackType/alliance and Sensing LOS for Mob. The extra nearest wrapper additionally applies its16-range noncombat visibility conditions. We do not relabel this as LOS-free universal ram targeting or audit unexpanded eligibility overrides.

Prepare entry requires LOOK registered, cooldown absent, nearest-visible present, RAM_TARGET absent. Start chooses nearest qualifying candidate only when visible snapshot returns one, then calculate-start. Fields are local Optional candidate and reachedTimestamp, not immutable accepted-victim receipt. Own start/stop do not unconditionally clear both fields on every invocation; chooseRamPosition resets timestamp/candidate when actually called. No stale-target exploit reproduced.

Calculate-start requires target block stable-destination and exact pathfindingmalus0, scans four horizontal rays up to7, backs off first invalid block and requires Manhattan distance>=4. Candidate starts sorted by goat block-position distance; first nonnull canReach path wins. This is an AI path request and local feasibility predicate, not actual route completion, loadedchunk guarantee or collision-engine acceptance.

Prepare tick requests WALK_TARGET(start,1.25,0) and eye-tracking LOOK_TARGET to held entity. If held target changes BLOCK position, broadcasts59, stops navigation and chooses again; continuous motion within same block is not that reset condition. canStillUse requires local candidate present and target alive only, not a full repeated RAM_TARGET_CONDITIONS or LOS test.

At goat start-block equality it broadcasts58, sets reachedTimestamp if absent, then when elapsed>=20 writes RAM_TARGET as target-block bottom-center plus directional half-block X/Z edge, plays prepare sound and clears candidate. Leaving start block without target-block change does not itself reset timestamp; do not promise20 contiguous stationary wallticks. Release is a Vec3 snapshot, not victim UUID or confirmed hit.

Prepare stop checks only absence of RAM_TARGET: if absent emits59 and writes fail cooldown minimum600 or100 according to current screaming flag. If RAM_TARGET exists, stop does not apply this failure cooldown. Generic Behavior finite160 entry clock and canStillUse semantics reused from actually-read110, not sourceproof replay; time budget is not completed preparation/attack evidence.

RamTarget entry requires cooldown absent and RAM_TARGET present; continuation only checks target memory present. Start latches ramDirection from current goat BLOCK integer X/Z minus stored Vec3, normalizes with Y0, and requests WALK_TARGET(storedVec,3,0). It does not retain or validate originally prepared victim identity, and does not recompute this latched direction each contact tick.

Contact tick performs a new getNearbyEntities(LivingEntity,conditions,goat,goat boundingbox); complete default EntityGetter helper filters rawquery list preserving its order without an added nearest sort. Only list.get(0) is processed. It need not be the prepared entity, and eligible living-contact branch precedes terrain/horn branch. Underlying world entity index, query intersection and arbitrary overrides not all read.

Contact requests hurt(noAggroMobAttack(goat), current ATTACK_DAMAGE), ignores boolean, then independently derives force, queries shield condition using a newly created ordinary mobAttack source, calls knockback, finishRam and impact sound. Actual source factories select MOB_ATTACK_NO_AGGRO vs MOB_ATTACK. Shield halving is a second source predicate, not the returned actual damage-block/HP receipt. No fixed accepted2HP or successful control promised.

Force is clamp(goat.getSpeed()*1.65,0.2,3)+0.25*(speed-effect-level minus slowdown-effect-level), then multiplied by shield?0.5:1 and age-selected1 or2.5. Effects adjustment is AFTER clamp, not a final total-force clamp. Generic native Living.knockback posts Forge hook, returns on cancel, uses modified strength/ratios then resistance, and only strength>0 updates impulse/delta. Request/sound/cooldown can therefore occur without admitted knockback or displacement; actual listeners/physics unverified.

If no eligible living contact, terrain test normalizes horizontal current delta, samples block at position+that direction and block.above against SNAPS_GOAT_HORN. main_independent_findings: setPlacedBy appends a Player profile directly before super; actual membership production is shown, but the superclass placement body and outer registry/runtime are not newly certified.

The first sharedUsers element defines owner; add uses UUID-else-name dedup while removal by name can remove the first element. Local MainMenu/whitelist/owner guards do not certify the outer C2S dispatcher; redstone parsing precedes them.
SharedUsers and HackedUsers name/UUID encodings are reached by parent save/load virtual calls through the ticking class. This is storage coding, but mutation dirtiness and actual flush are unproved.
The reader clears then parses shared before hacked; malformed UUID can leave partially replaced state and no catch/transaction is shown. Null UUID writing is not protected here.

Positive rebootTimer bypass, shared profile membership and old hacked membership are current authorization inputs. Station tick138–171 was not read anew; no expiry, revoke-time or lifetime claim is made.
Player contains(profile) and UUID overload comparison differ; GameProfile equals implementation and offline identity semantics remain dependencies.
clearRemoved/setRemoved add/remove after super; cache side partition, weak membership and world identity unload removal support current lookup, without proving chunk reload reconstruction.
Actual lookup filters removed/dimension/network and inclusive spatial bounds; placement of another station uses inflated16. Range-manager internals and coverage persistence are not read.
Any denying eligible station protects the location; another allowing station does not override it. Counts, UUID overloads, graph slots and axis variants are support within this single policy.
The complete network graph checks require one subroutine/IO/registry and connecting paths; they support active eligibility rather than extra independent credit.
HIGHEST interaction handler requires ServerPlayer and loaded target; right-click station itself is exempt while left-click is not. Local interaction does not call the place/break exemption helper.
Interaction denial explicitly requests RED overlay feedback and, for BlockItem, a selected-slot packet before returning false for event cancellation. It does not infer denial from absent damage.

The interaction stack may be offhand while packet index still uses inventory.selected. This is a source-level argument mismatch risk, not a proven client corruption or exploitable runtime bug; packet consumer is unreviewed.

Multiplace cancels the passed event at first protected snapshot; single place and break cancel their own events with RED messages. Engine rollback and subsequent event-bus arbitration remain unproved.
Creative/config or permission2 exemptions appear in place/break/explosion, not local interaction; entry-point differences are observations, not a confirmed bypass.

ExplosionStart only removes protected positions for indirect Player/server/nonexempt source; list-population/rebuild timing is unreviewed. This is not confirmed anti-explosion protection or total event cancellation.

Station useWithoutItem gates network/already-hacked/security level then may invoke old hacking; shift PASS and unconditional terminal SUCCESS do not certify menu access. Failure hurt result is ignored.

Old simulation edge/cancel/retaliation/addHacker, old projectile-owner suppression, permanent retame, foreign-owner damage denial, hostility reversal and saved migration inventory readers remain their complete old owners.

This one policy concerns persisted area membership plus eligible multistation any-denier and action-specific explicit refusal/correction requests; it is not a new hack-grant, generic NBT migration, entity damage immunity or late-event arbitration.
The fixed source uses NeoForge/new APIs; no 1.20.1 port, deployed registration, native Boss feedback, client visual, temporal completeness or production compatibility has been validated.

For foreign owners the server TRUSTED branch reads actual owner frequency UUID membership; missing frequency denies; the client branch is deliberately optimistic and not a server-authoritative membership cache.

Global owner policy overrides local mode only when override is enabled and moreRestrictive evaluates true. The full PUBLIC/PRIVATE/TRUSTED composition is preserved, not treated as arbitrary last-write priority.

Security desk removing a trusted UUID rechecks only that online player's actual currently open ISecurityContainer; mode tightening and override changes recheck online menus. Denied current menus close. The effect is actual existing-session revocation rather than another static allowlist test.
MekanismTileContainer extends MekanismContainer; Main additionally read the original superclass declaration implementing ISecurityContainer, closing that concrete instanceof consumption link.

Per-block local mode changes call onSecurityChanged, which takes a snapshot of playersUsing and rechecks access before closeContainer. Open/close update playersUsing. stillValid only checks GUI/removed/loaded state and is not falsely credited as the whole authorization check.

Next ordinary open/wrench explicitly checks canAccessOrDisplayError before menu opening, dismantle or rotation. The actual rejection producer is RED NO_ACCESS systemmessage. Current-session close itself has no equivalent explicit message call.

PacketAddTrusted and PacketGuiInteract selected native entry and action consumers are read; these local methods do not establish complete dispatcher/distance/current-menu/owner authentication or a network safety result.

addTrustedUser先以双方非null UUID相等、否则name相等去重，新增后请求description同步；removeTrustedUser按名字移除全部匹配并请求同步。移除方法本身未排除首元素，可能改变后续首元素归属；没有实机越权或界面可达性结论。
旧addHacker的去重、hacked列表增加、simulation完成/取消/报复整体保持旧owner；本候选只把已获hacked成员作为保护权限输入，不再次把grant包装为新机制。
writer以SharedUsers/HackedUsers分别写name与uuid文本；reader先清shared再解析添加，再清hacked并解析添加。UUID.fromString未捕获，writer假定id可toString；未观察到事务恢复或旧字段迁移。
父AbstractPneumaticCraftBlockEntity.saveAdditional最后虚调用writeToPacket，loadAdditional最后虚调用readFromPacket；通过AbstractTickingBlockEntity继承链到站点override。因此两个名单不仅是画面缓存，也参与当前存档编码与读取。
站点loadAdditional先调用父reader，再恢复startupTimer、inventory并重算validNetwork；saveAdditional先父writer，再存timer和Items。该通用timer/inventory派生网络reader已经迁移研究判duplicate0，本次不将其拆出重计。
Player权限谓词为rebootTimer>0或sharedUsers.contains(profile)或hackedUsers.contains(profile)；UUID重载以各profile.getId().equals(playerID)匹配。代码层比较入口不同，不推断authlib.equals内部细节或离线同名必然结果。
本次只把positive rebootTimer作为权限谓词输入；rebootStation设置timer并发送停机声请求。没有重跑旧simulation tick证明、没有新读138–171行，不新增timer倒计时/完成清名单/取消结算结论或TTL信用。
clearRemoved/setRemoved在super后分别加入/移出GlobalBlockEntityCacheManager；缓存分客户端和服务端，内部weak set；world unload按be.getLevel()==world移除。活跃保护查询还重查!removed、dimension比较为0、hasValidNetwork。
getSecurityCoverage委托rangeManager.getExtents；isValidAndInRange用XYZ包含两边界比较。尝试放安全站时coverage inflatedBy(16)，普通操作用原extents。没有把坐标轴、常量、范围helper计数。
getSecurityStations遍历当前侧缓存并应用上述资格；Player和UUID保护重载都anyMatch(!doesAllowPlayer)，所以一个允许站点不覆盖另一有效站点的拒绝；count重载仅另一视图，合并为同一场景。
Listener以modid Names.MOD_ID注册NeoForge订阅、左右键HIGHEST入口。handleInteraction只对ServerPlayer且目标已loaded进入策略；右键安全站本体被特殊排除，左键本体仍进入。该豁免不等于所有世界操作均豁免。

交互拒绝时选普通accessPrevented或stationPlacementPrevented翻译key，RED+overlay true发给该玩家；如果手持BlockItem，再发送ClientboundContainerSetSlotPacket(-2,0,inventory.selected,heldItem)，随后返回false让左右键订阅取消事件。消息和槽纠正是明确拒绝分支的后果，不是由成功返回反推。
方块放置订阅只在非客户端Player且非isPlayerExempt时检查；多放置按replaced snapshots逐个直到第一个拒绝；拒绝后取消整个传入事件并发红色overlay消息。未宣称引擎已实际回滚所有方块或NBT。
破坏订阅为兼顾其他模组fake player直接BreakEvent入口，对非exempt且被保护者取消并发红字；没有新编造fake player身份保证、真实跨模组回归或Boss灰字。
isPlayerExempt为creative&&配置或权限2；源码只在place/break/explosion路径调用，handleInteraction本地没有调用。保留入口检查差异，不宣称可利用或所有上游已统一认证。
ExplosionEvent.Start只对getIndirectSourceEntity为Player、非exempt且server的源，从getToBlow列表removeIf保护位置，不取消整个爆炸也不在此发拒绝消息；列表此时是否已填充/后续是否重建尚未读NeoForge引擎。

SharedUsers and HackedUsers name/UUID encodings are reached by parent save/load virtual calls through the ticking class. This is storage coding, but mutation dirtiness and actual flush are unproved.
The reader clears then parses shared before hacked; malformed UUID can leave partially replaced state and no catch/transaction is shown. Null UUID writing is not protected here.

Positive rebootTimer bypass, shared profile membership and old hacked membership are current authorization inputs. Station tick138–171 was not read anew; no expiry, revoke-time or lifetime claim is made.
Player contains(profile) and UUID overload comparison differ; GameProfile equals implementation and offline identity semantics remain dependencies.
clearRemoved/setRemoved add/remove after super; cache side partition, weak membership and world identity unload removal support current lookup, without proving chunk reload reconstruction.

Any denying eligible station protects the location; another allowing station does not override it. Counts, UUID overloads, graph slots and axis variants are support within this single policy.
The complete network graph checks require one subroutine/IO/registry and connecting paths; they support active eligibility rather than extra independent credit.
HIGHEST interaction handler requires ServerPlayer and loaded target; right-click station itself is exempt while left-click is not. Local interaction does not call the place/break exemption helper.
Interaction denial explicitly requests RED overlay feedback and, for BlockItem, a selected-slot packet before returning false for event cancellation. It does not infer denial from absent damage.

The interaction stack may be offhand while packet index still uses inventory.selected. This is a source-level argument mismatch risk, not a proven client corruption or exploitable runtime bug; packet consumer is unreviewed.

Multiplace cancels the passed event at first protected snapshot; single place and break cancel their own events with RED messages. Engine rollback and subsequent event-bus arbitration remain unproved.
Creative/config or permission2 exemptions appear in place/break/explosion, not local interaction; entry-point differences are observations, not a confirmed bypass.

ExplosionStart only removes protected positions for indirect Player/server/nonexempt source; list-population/rebuild timing is unreviewed. This is not confirmed anti-explosion protection or total event cancellation.

Station useWithoutItem gates network/already-hacked/security level then may invoke old hacking; shift PASS and unconditional terminal SUCCESS do not certify menu access. Failure hurt result is ignored.

Old simulation edge/cancel/retaliation/addHacker, old projectile-owner suppression, permanent retame, foreign-owner damage denial, hostility reversal and saved migration inventory readers remain their complete old owners.

addTrustedUser先以双方非null UUID相等、否则name相等去重，新增后请求description同步；removeTrustedUser按名字移除全部匹配并请求同步。移除方法本身未排除首元素，可能改变后续首元素归属；没有实机越权或界面可达性结论。
旧addHacker的去重、hacked列表增加、simulation完成/取消/报复整体保持旧owner；本候选只把已获hacked成员作为保护权限输入，不再次把grant包装为新机制。
writer以SharedUsers/HackedUsers分别写name与uuid文本；reader先清shared再解析添加，再清hacked并解析添加。UUID.fromString未捕获，writer假定id可toString；未观察到事务恢复或旧字段迁移。
父AbstractPneumaticCraftBlockEntity.saveAdditional最后虚调用writeToPacket，loadAdditional最后虚调用readFromPacket；通过AbstractTickingBlockEntity继承链到站点override。因此两个名单不仅是画面缓存，也参与当前存档编码与读取。
站点loadAdditional先调用父reader，再恢复startupTimer、inventory并重算validNetwork；saveAdditional先父writer，再存timer和Items。该通用timer/inventory派生网络reader已经迁移研究判duplicate0，本次不将其拆出重计。
Player权限谓词为rebootTimer>0或sharedUsers.contains(profile)或hackedUsers.contains(profile)；UUID重载以各profile.getId().equals(playerID)匹配。代码层比较入口不同，不推断authlib.equals内部细节或离线同名必然结果。
本次只把positive rebootTimer作为权限谓词输入；rebootStation设置timer并发送停机声请求。没有重跑旧simulation tick证明、没有新读138–171行，不新增timer倒计时/完成清名单/取消结算结论或TTL信用。
clearRemoved/setRemoved在super后分别加入/移出GlobalBlockEntityCacheManager；缓存分客户端和服务端，内部weak set；world unload按be.getLevel()==world移除。活跃保护查询还重查!removed、dimension比较为0、hasValidNetwork。
getSecurityCoverage委托rangeManager.getExtents；isValidAndInRange用XYZ包含两边界比较。尝试放安全站时coverage inflatedBy(16)，普通操作用原extents。没有把坐标轴、常量、范围helper计数。
getSecurityStations遍历当前侧缓存并应用上述资格；Player和UUID保护重载都anyMatch(!doesAllowPlayer)，所以一个允许站点不覆盖另一有效站点的拒绝；count重载仅另一视图，合并为同一场景。
Listener以modid Names.MOD_ID注册NeoForge订阅、左右键HIGHEST入口。handleInteraction只对ServerPlayer且目标已loaded进入策略；右键安全站本体被特殊排除，左键本体仍进入。该豁免不等于所有世界操作均豁免。

交互拒绝时选普通accessPrevented或stationPlacementPrevented翻译key，RED+overlay true发给该玩家；如果手持BlockItem，再发送ClientboundContainerSetSlotPacket(-2,0,inventory.selected,heldItem)，随后返回false让左右键订阅取消事件。消息和槽纠正是明确拒绝分支的后果，不是由成功返回反推。

两个block的useItemOn最终均返回SUCCESS，即使先前canOpen拒绝或没有真正open。拒绝结论来自真实canOpen false与明确消息producer，不从SUCCESS反推。

main_independent_findings: Concrete physical controller and wormhole entry checks a static ConcurrentMap<BlockPos,UUID> through canOpen. A foreign UUID produces RED container_already_open systemmessage and prevents this openMenu branch; same UUID remains admissible. This is one temporary occupancy control mechanism, not a permanent trusted-member authorization policy.

canOpen performs separate contains/get and reserve performs put after openMenu with no actual successful-menu receipt. ConcurrentMap does not make that composite admission atomic. BlockPos alone omits dimension/server/session namespace; no runtime race or exploit is asserted.

Controller and wormhole physical blocks return SUCCESS independently of denial. Wormhole reserves the local entrance position, not the linked controller position. Its missing loaded-controller message is a separate branch of this same scene, not another credit.

Base removed first updates crafting/order state and calls super, then removes every map entry whose value equals this player UUID. It does not compare an exact menu token or position, does not use finally, and does not establish all native disconnect/death/level-change callback paths.

Physical controller stillValid checks current BE object identity, loaded state/distance and a forty-worldtick refresh; wormhole checks current local BE plus resolved linked controller identity and local distance. Neither shown method rechecks or owns a distinct occupancy reservation.

Ordinary remote use and the empty C2S remote-open consumer select an actual remote and open the storage menu without the same direct canOpen/reserve calls. Ordinary use includes hasChunkAt while message consumer does not; this difference is not treated as verified network bypass. Remote inherits UUID-wide base removal, which can clear physical occupancy belonging to the same UUID.

Remote menu selected inventory index versus curio reselection and CuriosUtil selected-first/curio-first/inventory fallback are real identity boundaries. UI mayPlace/mayPickup locks do not create an immutable stack/session token. GlobalBlockPos carries dimension for remote references while occupancy map does not.

Global reference helper only resolves loaded blocks, cross-dimension server lookup and immediate BE access as shown; registry/menu factories and ctx.player dispatch bind concrete consumers. Matrix/order codecs, components, message wrappers, block variants and helpers are support0 under their preserved old owners.

Compared complete eight saved migration/sweep judgments, seven formal Occultism judgments, three full lease/fight judgments, current119 substantive owner and the already independently reviewed120 whole. Existing save/worker FIFO, fairy/guardian/effect/damage/eye feedback and queen/watcher/ritual families stay whole. Accepted unit is the distinct position-keyed temporary occupancy-refusal/release implementation including its remote coverage divergence; at most one, no per-branch/map/UUID/codec credit.

complete_saved_three_additional_judgment.full_chain_observation:
Registered Underzealot goals capture a valid ground-near sacrifice and startRiding without checking returned success. Target selection/hurt-alert suppressed while carrying/leader carrying/praying. Actual carrying sync flag is updated from passenger presence in server tick after super.tick.
Complete ritual goal separates follower and carrier eligibility. Followers seek ring positions, pray near altar and increment shared-looking but per-entity synced worship time; carrier >200 worship ticks plus >=3 praying followers triggers passenger.triggerSacrificeIn(300), then consumes local cloudCooldown400 and publishes event62. Validity/altar/position/digging and stop logic differ from later victim countdown.
Native hurt calls super first; only true plus isVehicle plus random<.65 ejects passengers. It does not itself clear victim isBeingSacrificed/sacrificeTime or immediately set carrying false. Goal stop resets worship/praying/particle position, ejects and conditionally sets carrier cooldown100. No rollback callback to committed victim timer.
Actual Gloomoth tick decrements armed sacrificeTime on server regardless of still being a passenger, then attempts Watcher conversion below0. Carrier postSacrifice/cooldown/advancement requires current Underzealot vehicle, but conversion does not. Vesper tick additionally requires isPassenger, so dismount pauses its timer without clearing the armed flag; later any passenger relation resumes, and conversion still does not require an Underzealot vehicle. Both trigger methods simply arm and replace timer.
Client events61/62 create particles/cloud,77 requests chant. ClientProxy type5 reuses sound by integer entity id and isSameEntity/alive; queues only if absent from queued/ticking lists and canPlaySound. UnderzealotSound canPlay requires !silent/praying/worship<MAX; running tick checks alive/praying, updates position/volume/pitch and stops otherwise. It does not itself stop when worship crosses MAX or silent changes. Removal clears map entry; no sound-manager stop call in that removal helper.
Native render burrow gate can suppress body; model carrying/praying interpolation reshapes pose, and armFreedom suppresses ordinary swing while carrying. These are state cues, not damage rejection text or verified visual feedback. Buried targetability/push/pick filters differ from hurt: own isInvulnerableTo only adds IN_WALL and super, not blanket buried invulnerability.

ISecurityUtils/IBlockSecurityUtils.INSTANCE经MekanismAPI.getService/getOptionalService，以API自身classloader查ServiceLoader首provider。四个security接口对应concrete实现声明已逐文核对；没有把服务声明存在等同实际生产Jar加载成功。
SecurityUtils Player入口在isOp允许时短路；UUID/provider入口先检查allowProtection。无security能力时有owner仅允许无owner或相同UUID；无owner且无security允许。能力缺失与完整安全策略不是同一输入。
实际security对象owner为空或与访问者相同直接允许；否则有效PUBLIC允许、PRIVATE拒绝，TRUSTED服务端要求非空subject并查询owner的SecurityFrequency.isTrusted(UUID)。缺少频率按拒绝处理；client TRUSTED显式乐观true，不是客户端持有完整成员名单。
全局owner策略并非最后写入覆盖本地模式：override启用且moreRestrictive(local,global)才替换。PUBLIC永不收紧，PRIVATE可收紧非PRIVATE，TRUSTED只收紧PUBLIC；更弱的全局模式不放宽更强本地限制。两次Objects.requireNonNull均检查base这一原文细节不升格为已证bug。
SecurityFrequency实际成员producer为addTrusted(UUID,name)去重后写UUID和名字cache，removeTrusted(index)按边界分别移除UUID/cache，setOverridden与继承setSecurityMode变更local dirty。成员身份、名字显示cache和同步hash明确分开。
安全桌toggleOverride改变频率、markForSave、发PacketSyncSecurity全玩家并validateAccess；setSecurityDeskMode仅发生mode变化时同样同步，仅更严格时重新验证。validateAccess遍历在线玩家检查其当前ISecurityContainer后关闭失去访问权限者。
安全桌removeTrusted按index取得被移除UUID，markForSave后只对该UUID在线玩家的当前容器重查，拒绝则closeContainer。这个撤权后既有会话关闭动作不是仅对下一次open的静态白名单谓词。
安全桌addTrusted以server.services().nameToIdCache().get(name)解析实际NameAndId再写UUID/name；方法本地未见markForSave。调用者及全域保存边界与显示/同步边界分开保留；不能据此认定实际丢档。
PacketGuiInteract和PacketAddTrusted已读局部server消费/安全桌调用入口，但外层dispatcher、当前菜单/距离/owner认证链未全读。此候选只描述这些被调用的服务端策略方法和实际消费，不声称任意网络输入都已获授权或有已证越权。

MekanismTileContainer.canPlayerAccess经IBlockSecurityUtils到SecurityUtils；TileEntityMekanism.open/close维护playersUsing，onSecurityChanged→BlockSecurityUtils.securityChanged对当前使用者快照逐一重查并关闭失去权限的容器。容器stillValid本地并不单独承担完整认证。
普通openGui的服务端/非潜行/hasGui分支实际先canAccessOrDisplayError，拒绝FAIL在openMenu之前；tryWrench拒绝返回NO_SECURITY在旋转/拆除之前。IBlockSecurityUtils默认helper在拒绝时服务端displayNoAccess，实际producer发RED格式NO_ACCESS systemmessage。
撤权closeContainer分支本地没有同样的displayNoAccess调用，不能把下次访问的红字提示反推为每次已开界面被关闭都会提示。slot纠正/动作栏和区域事件取消不在本Mek候选里编造。
安全桌的实际tile注册与普通mekBuilder条件owner/security能力声明已读；withSimple内部提供者/全部capability注册生命周期未全追。不把Entity/Item实现头和接口变体另计，候选明确以已追的block/menu消费为范围。
SecurityFrequency完整磁盘CODEC包含owner UUID、securityMode、override与trusted UUID列表；streamcodec使用trusted名字cache而非该UUID列表。PacketSyncSecurity是客户端当前owner/security资料更新，不是磁盘保存回执。
FrequencyLookup为SavedData，实际codec把频率列表交frequencyType.codec编码；controller通过serverdataStorage.computeIfAbsent载入。新增/删除频率或update/deactivate true、tickable聚合true会显式setDirty，既有getOrCreate/validate并不无条件dirty。
安全桌markForSave→TileEntityUpdateable.setChanged(false)→WorldUtils.markChunkDirty，完整已读方法只将已加载FULL chunk标记unsaved。它不是FrequencyLookup.setDirty回执，缺失chunk时也不强行载入。

完整TileComponentFrequency实际serializeFrequency保存identity serializer+getIdentity，而非注释所说full frequency data；UUID identity只有owner与mode，SecurityFrequency.getIdentity还固定PUBLIC。因此区块identity不能冒充完整trusted/override政策的另一路落盘。

完整Frequency181行的update/onDeactivate均false，SecurityFrequency无相关override；完整component495行每5tick对有效selected不再validateAndUpdate，只处理删除/非security撤权，invalid分支才重绑定。invalidate只调继承deactivate，configcard/implicitcomponent不传Security，未发现这些方法补全global dirty桥。
SECURITY声明PUBLIC_ONLY、UUIDidentity、needsTick=false，manager只注册needsTick者；QIO为true，其实际tick返回继承dirty，lookup.tickSelf才向SavedData.setDirty传播。QIO驱动器随机saveAll另有dirty域，不可移植当成Security桥，也不新计QIO原有库存/转移owner。

实际读取官方Mojang26.3客户端精确class的SavedData全4方法与SavedDataStorage选定12方法Code/constantpool/Bootstrap：existing computeIfAbsent/get路径不另setDirty，missing构造后set；collect lambda明确filter SavedData.isDirty，再encode/mapput后setDirty(false)。这建立vanilla静态筛选契约，不是类名/哈希猜测。
官方scheduleSave在收集map为空时返回completedFuture，close/saveAndJoin仍经同样收集。tryWrite方法调用压缩写并catch/log IOException；未读其完整异步worker或执行I/O，不能把排队、join或标记清除当磁盘耐久成功证明。

complete_current119_object.full_chain_observation:
实际权限生产点是SecurityStationBlock.setPlacedBy：放置者为Player时直接把profile放入sharedUsers，继而调用super。站点构造绑定SECURITY_STATION BlockEntity；这不是按注册ID或方块种类新增信用。
站点本地isOwner读取非空sharedUsers首元素，并调用当前profile.equals；增加/删除共享者仅在本地MainMenu且已白名单的分支中继续检查isOwner。没有宣称完整C2S外层认证已经审过。
addTrustedUser先以双方非null UUID相等、否则name相等去重，新增后请求description同步；removeTrustedUser按名字移除全部匹配并请求同步。移除方法本身未排除首元素，可能改变后续首元素归属；没有实机越权或界面可达性结论。
旧addHacker的去重、hacked列表增加、simulation完成/取消/报复整体保持旧owner；本候选只把已获hacked成员作为保护权限输入，不再次把grant包装为新机制。
writer以SharedUsers/HackedUsers分别写name与uuid文本；reader先清shared再解析添加，再清hacked并解析添加。UUID.fromString未捕获，writer假定id可toString；未观察到事务恢复或旧字段迁移。
父AbstractPneumaticCraftBlockEntity.saveAdditional最后虚调用writeToPacket，loadAdditional最后虚调用readFromPacket；通过AbstractTickingBlockEntity继承链到站点override。因此两个名单不仅是画面缓存，也参与当前存档编码与读取。
站点loadAdditional先调用父reader，再恢复startupTimer、inventory并重算validNetwork；saveAdditional先父writer，再存timer和Items。该通用timer/inventory派生网络reader已经迁移研究判duplicate0，本次不将其拆出重计。
Player权限谓词为rebootTimer>0或sharedUsers.contains(profile)或hackedUsers.contains(profile)；UUID重载以各profile.getId().equals(playerID)匹配。代码层比较入口不同，不推断authlib.equals内部细节或离线同名必然结果。
本次只把positive rebootTimer作为权限谓词输入；rebootStation设置timer并发送停机声请求。没有重跑旧simulation tick证明、没有新读138–171行，不新增timer倒计时/完成清名单/取消结算结论或TTL信用。
clearRemoved/setRemoved在super后分别加入/移出GlobalBlockEntityCacheManager；缓存分客户端和服务端，内部weak set；world unload按be.getLevel()==world移除。活跃保护查询还重查!removed、dimension比较为0、hasValidNetwork。
getSecurityCoverage委托rangeManager.getExtents；isValidAndInRange用XYZ包含两边界比较。尝试放安全站时coverage inflatedBy(16)，普通操作用原extents。没有把坐标轴、常量、范围helper计数。
getSecurityStations遍历当前侧缓存并应用上述资格；Player和UUID保护重载都anyMatch(!doesAllowPlayer)，所以一个允许站点不覆盖另一有效站点的拒绝；count重载仅另一视图，合并为同一场景。
Listener以modid Names.MOD_ID注册NeoForge订阅、左右键HIGHEST入口。handleInteraction只对ServerPlayer且目标已loaded进入策略；右键安全站本体被特殊排除，左键本体仍进入。该豁免不等于所有世界操作均豁免。
交互拒绝时选普通accessPrevented或stationPlacementPrevented翻译key，RED+overlay true发给该玩家；如果手持BlockItem，再发送ClientboundContainerSetSlotPacket(-2,0,inventory.selected,heldItem)，随后返回false让左右键订阅取消事件。消息和槽纠正是明确拒绝分支的后果，不是由成功返回反推。
方块放置订阅只在非客户端Player且非isPlayerExempt时检查；多放置按replaced snapshots逐个直到第一个拒绝；拒绝后取消整个传入事件并发红色overlay消息。未宣称引擎已实际回滚所有方块或NBT。
破坏订阅为兼顾其他模组fake player直接BreakEvent入口，对非exempt且被保护者取消并发红字；没有新编造fake player身份保证、真实跨模组回归或Boss灰字。
isPlayerExempt为creative&&配置或权限2；源码只在place/break/explosion路径调用，handleInteraction本地没有调用。保留入口检查差异，不宣称可利用或所有上游已统一认证。
ExplosionEvent.Start只对getIndirectSourceEntity为Player、非exempt且server的源，从getToBlow列表removeIf保护位置，不取消整个爆炸也不在此发拒绝消息；列表此时是否已填充/后续是否重建尚未读NeoForge引擎。
站点本体useWithoutItem对非白名单先看network有效/已hacked/安全级别，再可能报错或发起旧破解；这支持权限入口特例，不把小游戏资格/动画/报复重复计数。

main_independent_findings: setPlacedBy appends a Player profile directly before super; actual membership production is shown, but the superclass placement body and outer registry/runtime are not newly certified.

The first sharedUsers element defines owner; add uses UUID-else-name dedup while removal by name can remove the first element. Local MainMenu/whitelist/owner guards do not certify the outer C2S dispatcher; redstone parsing precedes them.
SharedUsers and HackedUsers name/UUID encodings are reached by parent save/load virtual calls through the ticking class. This is storage coding, but mutation dirtiness and actual flush are unproved.
The reader clears then parses shared before hacked; malformed UUID can leave partially replaced state and no catch/transaction is shown. Null UUID writing is not protected here.

Positive rebootTimer bypass, shared profile membership and old hacked membership are current authorization inputs. Station tick138–171 was not read anew; no expiry, revoke-time or lifetime claim is made.
Player contains(profile) and UUID overload comparison differ; GameProfile equals implementation and offline identity semantics remain dependencies.

实际权限生产点是SecurityStationBlock.setPlacedBy：放置者为Player时直接把profile放入sharedUsers，继而调用super。站点构造绑定SECURITY_STATION BlockEntity；这不是按注册ID或方块种类新增信用。
站点本地isOwner读取非空sharedUsers首元素，并调用当前profile.equals；增加/删除共享者仅在本地MainMenu且已白名单的分支中继续检查isOwner。没有宣称完整C2S外层认证已经审过。
addTrustedUser先以双方非null UUID相等、否则name相等去重，新增后请求description同步；removeTrustedUser按名字移除全部匹配并请求同步。移除方法本身未排除首元素，可能改变后续首元素归属；没有实机越权或界面可达性结论。
旧addHacker的去重、hacked列表增加、simulation完成/取消/报复整体保持旧owner；本候选只把已获hacked成员作为保护权限输入，不再次把grant包装为新机制。
writer以SharedUsers/HackedUsers分别写name与uuid文本；reader先清shared再解析添加，再清hacked并解析添加。UUID.fromString未捕获，writer假定id可toString；未观察到事务恢复或旧字段迁移。
父AbstractPneumaticCraftBlockEntity.saveAdditional最后虚调用writeToPacket，loadAdditional最后虚调用readFromPacket；通过AbstractTickingBlockEntity继承链到站点override。因此两个名单不仅是画面缓存，也参与当前存档编码与读取。
站点loadAdditional先调用父reader，再恢复startupTimer、inventory并重算validNetwork；saveAdditional先父writer，再存timer和Items。该通用timer/inventory派生网络reader已经迁移研究判duplicate0，本次不将其拆出重计。
Player权限谓词为rebootTimer>0或sharedUsers.contains(profile)或hackedUsers.contains(profile)；UUID重载以各profile.getId().equals(playerID)匹配。代码层比较入口不同，不推断authlib.equals内部细节或离线同名必然结果。
本次只把positive rebootTimer作为权限谓词输入；rebootStation设置timer并发送停机声请求。没有重跑旧simulation tick证明、没有新读138–171行，不新增timer倒计时/完成清名单/取消结算结论或TTL信用。
clearRemoved/setRemoved在super后分别加入/移出GlobalBlockEntityCacheManager；缓存分客户端和服务端，内部weak set；world unload按be.getLevel()==world移除。活跃保护查询还重查!removed、dimension比较为0、hasValidNetwork。
getSecurityCoverage委托rangeManager.getExtents；isValidAndInRange用XYZ包含两边界比较。尝试放安全站时coverage inflatedBy(16)，普通操作用原extents。没有把坐标轴、常量、范围helper计数。
getSecurityStations遍历当前侧缓存并应用上述资格；Player和UUID保护重载都anyMatch(!doesAllowPlayer)，所以一个允许站点不覆盖另一有效站点的拒绝；count重载仅另一视图，合并为同一场景。

交互拒绝时选普通accessPrevented或stationPlacementPrevented翻译key，RED+overlay true发给该玩家；如果手持BlockItem，再发送ClientboundContainerSetSlotPacket(-2,0,inventory.selected,heldItem)，随后返回false让左右键订阅取消事件。消息和槽纠正是明确拒绝分支的后果，不是由成功返回反推。
方块放置订阅只在非客户端Player且非isPlayerExempt时检查；多放置按replaced snapshots逐个直到第一个拒绝；拒绝后取消整个传入事件并发红色overlay消息。未宣称引擎已实际回滚所有方块或NBT。
破坏订阅为兼顾其他模组fake player直接BreakEvent入口，对非exempt且被保护者取消并发红字；没有新编造fake player身份保证、真实跨模组回归或Boss灰字。
isPlayerExempt为creative&&配置或权限2；源码只在place/break/explosion路径调用，handleInteraction本地没有调用。保留入口检查差异，不宣称可利用或所有上游已统一认证。

站点本体useWithoutItem对非白名单先看network有效/已hacked/安全级别，再可能报错或发起旧破解；这支持权限入口特例，不把小游戏资格/动画/报复重复计数。

SharedUsers and HackedUsers name/UUID encodings are reached by parent save/load virtual calls through the ticking class. This is storage coding, but mutation dirtiness and actual flush are unproved.
The reader clears then parses shared before hacked; malformed UUID can leave partially replaced state and no catch/transaction is shown. Null UUID writing is not protected here.

Positive rebootTimer bypass, shared profile membership and old hacked membership are current authorization inputs. Station tick138–171 was not read anew; no expiry, revoke-time or lifetime claim is made.
Player contains(profile) and UUID overload comparison differ; GameProfile equals implementation and offline identity semantics remain dependencies.
clearRemoved/setRemoved add/remove after super; cache side partition, weak membership and world identity unload removal support current lookup, without proving chunk reload reconstruction.
Actual lookup filters removed/dimension/network and inclusive spatial bounds; placement of another station uses inflated16. Range-manager internals and coverage persistence are not read.
Any denying eligible station protects the location; another allowing station does not override it. Counts, UUID overloads, graph slots and axis variants are support within this single policy.
The complete network graph checks require one subroutine/IO/registry and connecting paths; they support active eligibility rather than extra independent credit.
HIGHEST interaction handler requires ServerPlayer and loaded target; right-click station itself is exempt while left-click is not. Local interaction does not call the place/break exemption helper.
Interaction denial explicitly requests RED overlay feedback and, for BlockItem, a selected-slot packet before returning false for event cancellation. It does not infer denial from absent damage.

The interaction stack may be offhand while packet index still uses inventory.selected. This is a source-level argument mismatch risk, not a proven client corruption or exploitable runtime bug; packet consumer is unreviewed.

Multiplace cancels the passed event at first protected snapshot; single place and break cancel their own events with RED messages. Engine rollback and subsequent event-bus arbitration remain unproved.
Creative/config or permission2 exemptions appear in place/break/explosion, not local interaction; entry-point differences are observations, not a confirmed bypass.

ExplosionStart only removes protected positions for indirect Player/server/nonexempt source; list-population/rebuild timing is unreviewed. This is not confirmed anti-explosion protection or total event cancellation.

Station useWithoutItem gates network/already-hacked/security level then may invoke old hacking; shift PASS and unconditional terminal SUCCESS do not certify menu access. Failure hurt result is ignored.

Old simulation edge/cancel/retaliation/addHacker, old projectile-owner suppression, permanent retame, foreign-owner damage denial, hostility reversal and saved migration inventory readers remain their complete old owners.

complete_saved_seven_formal_occultism_ju.full_chain_observation: 实际实体registerGoals接RayGoal，按owner最近受击者/攻击者列表→server发送MessageBeholderAttack到施法者tracking，attackTimer=23；稍后重新以目标numeric ID查询执行hurt且不使用返回值。client收到后shootRay给最多4只眼各取一个目标，prepareShot=20；native tick每眼递减，最后4个tick发dust射线，目标每次由本world实体eyePosition(0)重取。固定包注册playToClient→MessageHandler→实际consumer，颜色由ColoredFamiliarEntity的同步RGB读取。
complete_saved_seven_formal_occultism_ju.concrete_observation: 计1：真实战斗预告的目标跟随/有限眼位租约与服务端延迟命中不同步策略，合并包/插值/尘线/目标ID生命周期为同一反馈链。不是实际免疫回执，视觉已播不证明伤害接受；getOwnerEnemies可重复同一实体，未UUID去重。最多4眼；每次shoot最多150点、步长0.1，碰终点膨胀AABB截断，没做方块遮挡射线。目标丢失时本次shoot返回，不排队重发；倒计时继续。包无UUID/dim/epoch，decode长度无显式上界；目标ID复用/跨world迟包风险仅静态可见。

complete_saved_seven_formal_occultism_ju.limitations: 实体及眼部所有关键类全文、RGB父类全文、真实packet/dispatch/发送方法全链已读。粒子使用原版Dust，未读平台dust渲染深度，不能称可见/遮挡通过。无游戏、画面或两TCP测试，普通图形/网络包装0额外。

实际权限生产点是SecurityStationBlock.setPlacedBy：放置者为Player时直接把profile放入sharedUsers，继而调用super。站点构造绑定SECURITY_STATION BlockEntity；这不是按注册ID或方块种类新增信用。
站点本地isOwner读取非空sharedUsers首元素，并调用当前profile.equals；增加/删除共享者仅在本地MainMenu且已白名单的分支中继续检查isOwner。没有宣称完整C2S外层认证已经审过。
addTrustedUser先以双方非null UUID相等、否则name相等去重，新增后请求description同步；removeTrustedUser按名字移除全部匹配并请求同步。移除方法本身未排除首元素，可能改变后续首元素归属；没有实机越权或界面可达性结论。
旧addHacker的去重、hacked列表增加、simulation完成/取消/报复整体保持旧owner；本候选只把已获hacked成员作为保护权限输入，不再次把grant包装为新机制。
writer以SharedUsers/HackedUsers分别写name与uuid文本；reader先清shared再解析添加，再清hacked并解析添加。UUID.fromString未捕获，writer假定id可toString；未观察到事务恢复或旧字段迁移。
父AbstractPneumaticCraftBlockEntity.saveAdditional最后虚调用writeToPacket，loadAdditional最后虚调用readFromPacket；通过AbstractTickingBlockEntity继承链到站点override。因此两个名单不仅是画面缓存，也参与当前存档编码与读取。
站点loadAdditional先调用父reader，再恢复startupTimer、inventory并重算validNetwork；saveAdditional先父writer，再存timer和Items。该通用timer/inventory派生网络reader已经迁移研究判duplicate0，本次不将其拆出重计。
Player权限谓词为rebootTimer>0或sharedUsers.contains(profile)或hackedUsers.contains(profile)；UUID重载以各profile.getId().equals(playerID)匹配。代码层比较入口不同，不推断authlib.equals内部细节或离线同名必然结果。
本次只把positive rebootTimer作为权限谓词输入；rebootStation设置timer并发送停机声请求。没有重跑旧simulation tick证明、没有新读138–171行，不新增timer倒计时/完成清名单/取消结算结论或TTL信用。
clearRemoved/setRemoved在super后分别加入/移出GlobalBlockEntityCacheManager；缓存分客户端和服务端，内部weak set；world unload按be.getLevel()==world移除。活跃保护查询还重查!removed、dimension比较为0、hasValidNetwork。
getSecurityCoverage委托rangeManager.getExtents；isValidAndInRange用XYZ包含两边界比较。尝试放安全站时coverage inflatedBy(16)，普通操作用原extents。没有把坐标轴、常量、范围helper计数。
getSecurityStations遍历当前侧缓存并应用上述资格；Player和UUID保护重载都anyMatch(!doesAllowPlayer)，所以一个允许站点不覆盖另一有效站点的拒绝；count重载仅另一视图，合并为同一场景。

破坏订阅为兼顾其他模组fake player直接BreakEvent入口，对非exempt且被保护者取消并发红字；没有新编造fake player身份保证、真实跨模组回归或Boss灰字。

ISecurityUtils/IBlockSecurityUtils.INSTANCE经MekanismAPI.getService/getOptionalService，以API自身classloader查ServiceLoader首provider。四个security接口对应concrete实现声明已逐文核对；没有把服务声明存在等同实际生产Jar加载成功。
SecurityUtils Player入口在isOp允许时短路；UUID/provider入口先检查allowProtection。无security能力时有owner仅允许无owner或相同UUID；无owner且无security允许。能力缺失与完整安全策略不是同一输入。
实际security对象owner为空或与访问者相同直接允许；否则有效PUBLIC允许、PRIVATE拒绝，TRUSTED服务端要求非空subject并查询owner的SecurityFrequency.isTrusted(UUID)。缺少频率按拒绝处理；client TRUSTED显式乐观true，不是客户端持有完整成员名单。
全局owner策略并非最后写入覆盖本地模式：override启用且moreRestrictive(local,global)才替换。PUBLIC永不收紧，PRIVATE可收紧非PRIVATE，TRUSTED只收紧PUBLIC；更弱的全局模式不放宽更强本地限制。两次Objects.requireNonNull均检查base这一原文细节不升格为已证bug。

每次use在当前手stack取HOOK_ENTITY_ID缺省0，当前Level按numericID找到LyssaHook就调用其handleHookRetraction后把本stackID写0；没有本地hook owner==本次player、UUID/dimension/session token校验。查不到同类则先音效，再server构造setOwner/射出并addFreshEntity，不验bool即存hookID；无论分支都SUCCESS。

无hooked或无owner落到super.retrieve(stack)，该返回值未被调用者使用。整个server分支之后仍pullItemEntitiesWithHook，查询hook附近ItemEntity并按owner与hook坐标赋速度；这在已discard后也会调用，方法本地没有alive门。不能把discard直接等同该次所有副作用已终止。

fallback扫描每轮先把stolenStack改成该槽stack，只在找到非空且可drop时更新slotBeingStolenFrom后break。若最终没有合格槽，但最后槽非空且不可drop，stolenStack可保留最后值而slotBeingStolenFrom仍初始empty槽。后续消费这两个变量分开，存在本地槽/载荷对应边界；不执行、不称实机复制或物品损失。

失败分支只hurt(playerAttack,0)请求再return，不读取是否hurt接纳或实际发怒；外层仍discard/清rodID并执行末尾附近物品拉动。无特定拒控text/reason或收费/冷却成功回执。
